<h1 id="upgrade-order-melee" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Upgrade Order - Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction-disclaimer"><ins><nowiki>Introduction &amp; Disclaimer</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel lists the recommended general melee purchase/unlock progression for players to follow.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Last Revised: 23rd October 2026</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The order is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>subject to change at any time</nowiki></strong><nowiki> as prices change, updates occur, and knowledge expands</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Please note the following assumptions:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The order assume a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>starting point of T70 gear</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442182029382.png?v=1" alt="dharokaxe" title="dharokaxe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643151021748518917.png?v=1" alt="bandoschest" title="bandoschest" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Priorities may be different</nowiki></strong><nowiki> if you are doing niche content</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ &quot;ROI&quot; (meaning return-on-investment) typically means </nowiki><strong><nowiki>quality-of-life upgrades or typical damage increase</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ We do </nowiki><strong><nowiki>not recommend selling an item to buy another</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, unless it is a direct upgrade</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Unlisted items</nowiki></strong><nowiki> are not worth buying</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Feel free to ask in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#pvm-help</nowiki></span><nowiki> for a tailored list to the content that you do!</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
